class RestaurantMention(BaseModel):
    found: bool
    restaurant_name: str
    message_body: str

)

    food_type: str

    "Given the following restaurant name, provide information about what kind of food they serve. Restaurant name: {}".format(restaurant_mention.restaurant_name),
    RestaurantFoodInfo,
)
